rules.name: create_id
rules.expr: ok and called("createAuction") and (ret != pre("nextAuctionId") or post("nextAuctionId") != pre("nextAuctionId") + 1)

rules.name: create_fields
rules.expr: ok and called("createAuction") and (post("auctions", ret, "seller") != sender or post("auctions", ret, "lotAmount") != arg(0) or post("auctions", ret, "reservePrice") != arg(1) or post("auctions", ret, "endTime") != now + arg(2) or post("auctions", ret, "settled") != 0 or post("auctions", ret, "highestBid") != 0 or post("auctions", ret, "highestBidder") != 0)

rules.name: create_escrow
rules.expr: ok and called("createAuction") and post("TokenC12.balanceOf", A0) != pre("TokenC12.balanceOf", A0) + arg(0)

rules.name: create_fresh
rules.expr: ok and called("createAuction") and pre("auctions", ret, "seller") != 0

rules.name: bid_window

params.forbidden: pre("auctions", arg(0), "seller") == 0 or pre("auctions", arg(0), "settled") != 0 or now >= pre("auctions", arg(0), "endTime") or sender == pre("auctions", arg(0), "seller")

rules.why: bids only on live auctions by non-sellers

rules.name: bid_escrow
rules.expr: ok and called("bid") and post("ETH", A0) != pre("ETH", A0) + post("auctions", arg(0), "highestBid")

rules.name: bid_leader
rules.expr: ok and called("bid") and post("auctions", arg(0), "highestBidder") != sender

rules.name: bid_increment
rules.expr: ok and called("bid") and pre("auctions", arg(0), "highestBid") > 0 and post("auctions", arg(0), "highestBid") * 10000 < pre("auctions", arg(0), "highestBid") * 10500

rules.name: bid_reserve
rules.expr: ok and called("bid") and pre("auctions", arg(0), "highestBid") == 0 and (post("auctions", arg(0), "highestBid") < pre("auctions", arg(0), "reservePrice") or post("auctions", arg(0), "highestBid") == 0)

rules.name: bid_refund_credit
rules.expr: ok and called("bid") and post_sum("pendingWithdrawals") != pre_sum("pendingWithdrawals") + pre("auctions", arg(0), "highestBid")

rules.name: bid_refund_to_prev
rules.expr: ok and called("bid") and pre("auctions", arg(0), "highestBidder") != 0 and post("pendingWithdrawals", pre("auctions", arg(0), "highestBidder")) != pre("pendingWithdrawals", pre("auctions", arg(0), "highestBidder")) + pre("auctions", arg(0), "highestBid")

rules.name: bid_extension
rules.expr: ok and called("bid") and (post("auctions", arg(0), "endTime") < now + 600 or post("auctions", arg(0), "endTime") < pre("auctions", arg(0), "endTime"))

rules.name: highest_monotone
rules.expr: ok and (called("bid") or called("settle") or called("cancel")) and post("auctions", arg(0), "highestBid") < pre("auctions", arg(0), "highestBid")

rules.name: endtime_monotone
rules.expr: ok and (called("bid") or called("settle") or called("cancel")) and pre("auctions", arg(0), "seller") != 0 and post("auctions", arg(0), "endTime") < pre("auctions", arg(0), "endTime")

params.forbidden: pre("auctions", arg(0), "seller") == 0 or pre("auctions", arg(0), "settled") != 0 or now < pre("auctions", arg(0), "endTime")

rules.name: settle_with_bid
rules.expr: ok and called("settle") and pre("auctions", arg(0), "highestBidder") != 0 and (post_sum("pendingWithdrawals") != pre_sum("pendingWithdrawals") + pre("auctions", arg(0), "highestBid") or post("pendingWithdrawals", pre("auctions", arg(0), "seller")) != pre("pendingWithdrawals", pre("auctions", arg(0), "seller")) + pre("auctions", arg(0), "highestBid") or post("TokenC12.balanceOf", A0) + pre("auctions", arg(0), "lotAmount") != pre("TokenC12.balanceOf", A0))

rules.name: settle_lot_to_winner
rules.expr: ok and called("settle") and pre("auctions", arg(0), "highestBidder") != 0 and pre("auctions", arg(0), "highestBidder") != A0 and post("TokenC12.balanceOf", pre("auctions", arg(0), "highestBidder")) != pre("TokenC12.balanceOf", pre("auctions", arg(0), "highestBidder")) + pre("auctions", arg(0), "lotAmount")

rules.name: settle_no_bid
rules.expr: ok and called("settle") and pre("auctions", arg(0), "highestBidder") == 0 and (post("TokenC12.balanceOf", pre("auctions", arg(0), "seller")) != pre("TokenC12.balanceOf", pre("auctions", arg(0), "seller")) + pre("auctions", arg(0), "lotAmount") or post_sum("pendingWithdrawals") != pre_sum("pendingWithdrawals"))
rules.why: no bids: lot back to seller

rules.name: settle_marks
rules.expr: ok and (called("settle") or called("cancel")) and post("auctions", arg(0), "settled") == 0

params.forbidden: sender != pre("auctions", arg(0), "seller") or pre("auctions", arg(0), "settled") != 0 or pre("auctions", arg(0), "highestBidder") != 0

rules.name: cancel_returns_lot
rules.expr: ok and called("cancel") and post("TokenC12.balanceOf", A0) + pre("auctions", arg(0), "lotAmount") != pre("TokenC12.balanceOf", A0)

rules.name: settled_frozen
rules.expr: ok and (called("bid") or called("settle") or called("cancel")) and pre("auctions", arg(0), "settled") != 0 and (post("auctions", arg(0), "settled") == 0 or post("auctions", arg(0), "highestBid") != pre("auctions", arg(0), "highestBid") or post("auctions", arg(0), "highestBidder") != pre("auctions", arg(0), "highestBidder"))

rules.name: terms_immutable
rules.expr: ok and (called("bid") or called("settle") or called("cancel")) and pre("auctions", arg(0), "seller") != 0 and (post("auctions", arg(0), "seller") != pre("auctions", arg(0), "seller") or post("auctions", arg(0), "lotAmount") != pre("auctions", arg(0), "lotAmount") or post("auctions", arg(0), "reservePrice") != pre("auctions", arg(0), "reservePrice"))

rules.name: withdraw_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and (post("pendingWithdrawals", sender) != 0 or post("ETH", A0) + pre("pendingWithdrawals", sender) != pre("ETH", A0))
rules.why: withdraw pays exactly the pending amount

rules.name: pending_third_party
rules.why: no one loses credit in others' calls

rules.name: pending_only_withdraw
rules.expr: ok and not called("withdraw") and post_sum("pendingWithdrawals") < pre_sum("pendingWithdrawals")

rules.name: eth_out_only_withdraw
rules.expr: ok and not called("withdraw") and post("ETH", A0) < pre("ETH", A0)

rules.name: lot_third_party
rules.expr: ok and (called("createAuction") or called("bid") or called("settle") or called("cancel") or called("withdraw")) and u != sender and u != A0 and post("TokenC12.balanceOf", u) < pre("TokenC12.balanceOf", u)
rules.why: no one loses lot tokens in others' calls
